name: Great Pyramid of Giza
fact: The oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, built about 4,500 years ago in Egypt.

name: Eiffel Tower
fact: Built in Paris for the 1889 World's Fair; about 330 m tall.

name: Taj Mahal
fact: A white marble mausoleum in Agra, India, built in the 17th century.

name: Machu Picchu
fact: A 15th century Inca citadel high in the Andes of Peru.

name: Great Wall of China, Badaling
fact: The Badaling section near Beijing, the most visited part of the wall.

name: Statue of Liberty
fact: A gift from France to the United States, on Liberty Island in New York Harbor.

name: Sydney Opera House
fact: Its shell-shaped roofs make it one of the best known buildings of the 20th century.

name: Mount Everest
fact: The highest mountain on Earth, 8,849 m, on the border of Nepal and China.

name: Grand Canyon
fact: Carved by the Colorado River over millions of years; up to 1.8 km deep.

name: Petra
fact: An ancient city carved into rose-coloured rock in southern Jordan.

name: Angkor Wat
fact: The largest religious monument in the world, in Cambodia.

name: Christ the Redeemer
fact: A 30 m statue on Corcovado mountain above Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

name: Colosseum
fact: The largest amphitheatre ever built, in the centre of Rome.

name: Burj Khalifa
fact: The tallest building in the world, 828 m, in Dubai.

name: Palm Jumeirah
fact: An artificial island in Dubai shaped like a palm tree, easy to spot from space.

name: Eye of the Sahara
fact: The Richat Structure: a 40 km wide rock formation in Mauritania, a landmark for astronauts.

name: Niagara Falls
fact: Three waterfalls on the border of Canada and the United States.

name: Victoria Falls
fact: One of the largest waterfalls in the world, on the Zambezi River between Zambia and Zimbabwe.

name: Iguazu Falls
fact: Hundreds of waterfalls on the border of Argentina and Brazil.

name: Mount Fuji
fact: Japan's highest mountain, 3,776 m, an almost perfect volcanic cone.

name: Uluru
fact: A giant sandstone monolith in the desert of central Australia.

name: Stonehenge
fact: A prehistoric stone circle in England, about 5,000 years old.

name: Chichen Itza
fact: A great Maya city in Mexico, crowned by the El Castillo pyramid.

name: Kaaba, Mecca
fact: The most sacred site in Islam, at the centre of the Masjid al-Haram.

name: Golden Gate Bridge
fact: A suspension bridge across the entrance to San Francisco Bay, opened in 1937.

name: Venice
fact: A city built on more than 100 small islands in a lagoon in northern Italy.

name: Suez Canal
fact: A 193 km canal linking the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea, opened in 1869.

name: Panama Canal, Miraflores Locks
fact: Locks lift ships up and down as they cross Panama between the Atlantic and the Pacific.

name: Dead Sea
fact: The lowest place on land, about 430 m below sea level.

name: Central Park, New York
fact: A long rectangle of green in the middle of Manhattan.

name: Mount Kilimanjaro
fact: Africa's highest mountain, 5,895 m, a dormant volcano in Tanzania.

name: Marina Bay Sands, Singapore
fact: Three towers joined by a sky park on top, beside Marina Bay.

name: Borobudur
fact: The world's largest Buddhist temple, in central Java, Indonesia.

name: Meeting of Waters, Manaus
fact: The dark Rio Negro meets the sandy Solimoes and they flow side by side for kilometres in the Amazon.

name: Ha Long Bay
fact: Thousands of limestone islands rising from the sea in northern Vietnam.

name: Bagan
fact: More than 2,000 Buddhist temples and pagodas on the plains of Myanmar.

name: Hagia Sophia
fact: A great domed building from the 6th century in Istanbul, Turkey.

name: Forbidden City
fact: The palace of Chinese emperors for almost 500 years, in the heart of Beijing.
